ubcj-dockbuilders-moa-2022-2027.notes: Current MOA (Feb. 1, 2022 - Jan. 31, 2027) for Dockbuilder and Supervisor Dockbuilder, NYC District Council of Carpenters, UBCJA, continues 'the predecessor Consent Determination, MOA, and related agreements'. The 2018 MOA is itself an amendment: 'the undersigned parties will continue all of the terms and conditions set forth In the 2005-08 Consent Determinations, except as provided herein' (p.1). It refers to Appendix A 'attached hereto' (p.4), but the published PDF has 5 pages and no Appendix A. It also says the parties will file separate 2008-2020 consent determinations for Ship Carpenters, Dockbuilders and Riggers (p.5). Neither the 2005-08 nor the 2008-2020 consent determinations for these titles appear on any OLR page scanned; the Carpenters 2008-2020 consent determination and MOA cover Carpenter and Supervisor Carpenter only. Chain stops here, not complete. Gap: the 2018 MOA ends Dec. 31, 2020 and the current MOA starts Feb. 1, 2022; nothing found covers Jan. 2021 - Jan. 2022.
